name: Oth
source:
One of the Ancients that came through the portal. He has a great physical strength, enough to separate limbs like if they were made of paper while enjoying his victims' suffering and screams.
[spoiler]He is one of the 7 old Ancients and his real name is Sloth, the red oaf.[/spoiler]
